card.name: Right before survive or live longer
card.fires_on: Words just before a predicted 'survive', 'alive', 'survival' or 'live' (longer), such as a subject, 'now', 'remain', or 'free-' in 'event-free survival'. It appears in texts about people surviving illness or danger.

modes.label: Subject before survive
modes.description: A person or group word right before a verb of surviving or living a long time.
modes.example: vowing to enter a life of religion should<< he>> survive.

modes.label: Survival outcome phrases
modes.description: Words in medical or trial text that lead into survival, longer life or remaining alive.
modes.example: Because more children with rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS<<)>> are surviving longer

modes.label: Lengthening life
modes.description: Words in phrases about extending a person's life.
modes.example: Treating those tumors would not length<<en>> a person's life

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict survive, alive and survival words next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say that someone survives or stays alive.
